ayahs.1: Alif Laam Meem Ra, yeh Quran ki aayaten hain, aur jo kuchh aap ki taraf aap ke Rabb ki jaanib se utaara jaata hai, sab haq hai lekin aksar log imaan nahin laate.
ayahs.2: Allah woh hai jis ne aasmanon ko baghair sutoon ke buland kar rakha hai ke tum use dekh rahe ho. Phir woh arsh par qaraar pakde hue hai, usi ne sooraj aur chaand ko maatehti mein laga rakha hai. Har ek miaad-e-muayyan par gasht kar raha hai, wahi kaam ki tadbeer karta hai, woh apne nishaanat khol khol kar bayan kar raha hai ke tum apne Rabb ki mulaaqaat ka yaqeen kar lo.
ayahs.3: Usi ne zameen phaila kar bichha di hai aur is mein pahaad aur nehren paida kardi hain. Aur is mein har qisam ke phalon ke jode dohre dohre paida kardiye hain, woh raat ko din se chhupa deta hai. Yaqeenan ghaur-o-fikr karne walon ke liye is mein bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.4: Aur zameen mein mukhtalif tukde ek doosre se lagte lagaate hain aur angooron ke baaghaat hain aur khet hain aur khajooron ke darakht hain, shaakh-daar aur baaz aise hain jo be-shaakh hain, sab ek hi paani pilaaye jaate hain. Phir bhi hum ek ko ek par phalon mein bartari dete hain, is mein aqal-mandon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.5: Agar tujhe taajjub ho to waaqai in ka yeh kehna ajeeb hai ke kya jab hum mitti ho jaayenge to kya hum nayi paidaish mein honge? Yehi woh log hain jinhon ne apne parwardigar se kufr kiya. Yehi hain jin ki gardanon mein tauq honge aur yehi hain jo jahannam ke rehne wale hain jo is mein hamesha hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.6: Aur jo tujh se (saza ki talabi mein) jald kar rahe hain raahat se pehle hi, yaqeenan un se pehle sazaayen (ba-taur-e-misaal) guzar chuki hain, aur beshak tera Rabb albatta bakhshne wala hai logon ke be-ja zulm par bhi. Aur yeh bhi yaqeeni baat hai ke tera Rabb badi sakht saza dene wala bhi hai.
ayahs.7: Aur kaafir kehte hain ke is par is ke Rabb ki taraf se koi nishani (mojiza) kyun nahin utaari gayi. Baat yeh hai ke aap to sirf aagah karne wale hain. Aur har qaum ke liye haadi hai.
ayahs.8: Maada apne shikam mein jo kuchh rakhti hai use Allah ba-khoobi jaanta hai aur pet ka ghatna badhna bhi, har cheez is ke paas andaaze se hai.
ayahs.9: Zaahir-o-posheeda ka woh aalim hai (sab se) bada aur (sab se) buland-o-baala.
ayahs.10: Tum mein se kisi ka apni baat ko chhupa kar kehna aur ba-awaz-e-buland use kehna aur jo raat ko chhupa hua ho aur jo din mein chal raha ho, sab Allah par baraabar yaksaan hain.
ayahs.11: Is ke pehre-daar insan ke aage peechhe muqarrar hain, jo Allah ke hukm se is ki nigehbaani karte hain. Kisi qaum ki haalat Allah Taala nahin badalta jab tak ke woh khud use na badlen jo un ke dilon mein hai. Allah Taala jab kisi qaum ki saza ka irada kar leta hai to woh badla nahin karta aur siwaye is ke koi bhi un ka kaarsaaz nahin.
ayahs.12: Woh Allah hi hai jo tumhein bijli ki chamak daraane aur umeed dilaane ke liye dikhaata hai aur bhaari baadalon ko paida karta hai.
ayahs.13: Garaj is ki tasbeeh-o-tareef karti hai aur farishte bhi, is ke khauf se. Wahi aasman se bijliyan giraata hai aur jis par chahta hai is par daalta hai, kuffaar Allah ki baabat lad jhagad rahe hain aur Allah sakht quwwat wala hai.
ayahs.14: Usi ko pukaarna haq hai. Jo log auron ko is ke siwa pukaarte hain woh un (ki pukaar) ka kuchh bhi jawab nahin dete magar jaise koi shakhs apne donon haath paani ki taraf phailaaye hue ho ke is ke munh mein pad jaaye, halaanke woh paani is ke munh mein pahunchne wala nahin, in munkiron ki jitni pukaar hai sab gumraahi mein hai.
ayahs.15: Allah hi ke liye zameen aur aasmanon ki sab makhlooq khushi aur na-khushi se sajda karti hai aur un ke saaye bhi subah-o-shaam.
ayahs.16: Aap poochhiye ke aasmanon aur zameen ka parwardigar kaun hai? Keh dijiye! Allah. Keh dijiye! Kya tum phir bhi is ke siwa auron ko himayati bana rahe ho jo khud apni jaan ke bhi bhale bure ka ikhtiyaar nahin rakhte. Keh dijiye ke kya andha aur beena baraabar ho sakta hai? Ya kya andheriyan aur raushni baraabar ho sakti hai. Kya jinhen yeh Allah ke shareek thehra rahe hain unhon ne bhi Allah ki tarah makhlooq paida ki hai ke un ki nazar mein paidaish mushtaba ho gayi ho, keh dijiye ke sirf Allah hi tamaam cheezon ka khaaliq hai, woh akela hai aur zabardast ghaalib hai.
ayahs.17: Usi ne aasman se paani barsaaya phir apni apni wusat ke mutaabiq naale bah nikle. Phir paani ke rele ne oopar chadhe jhaag ko utha liya, aur is cheez mein bhi jis ko aag mein daal kar tapaate hain zewar ya saaz-o-samaan ke liye isi tarah ke jhaag hain, isi tarah Allah Taala haq-o-baatil ki misaal bayan farmaata hai, ab jhaag to naakaara ho kar chala jaata hai lekin jo logon ko nafa dene wali cheez hai woh zameen mein thehri rehti hai, Allah Taala isi tarah misaalen bayan farmaata hai.
ayahs.18: Jin logon ne apne Rabb ke hukm ki baja-aawari ki un ke liye bhalaai hai aur jin logon ne is ki hukm-bardaari na ki agar un ke liye zameen mein jo kuchh hai sab kuchh ho aur usi ke saath waisa hi aur bhi ho to woh sab kuchh apne badle mein de den. Yehi hain jin ke liye bura hisaab hai aur jin ka thikaana jahannam hai jo bahut buri jagah hai.
ayahs.19: Kya woh ek shakhs jo yeh ilm rakhta ho ke aap ki taraf aap ke Rabb ki jaanib se jo utaara gaya hai woh haq hai, is shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo andha ho? Naseehat to wahi qabool karte hain jo aqalmand hon.
ayahs.20: Jo Allah ke ahd (o-paimaan) ko poora karte hain aur qaul-o-qaraar ko todte nahin.
ayahs.21: Aur Allah ne jin cheezon ke jodne ka hukm diya hai woh use jodte hain aur woh apne parwardigar se darte hain aur hisaab ki sakhti ka andesha rakhte hain.
ayahs.22: Aur woh apne Rabb ki raza-mandi ki talab ke liye sabr karte hain, aur namazon ko baraabar qaim rakhte hain aur jo kuchh hum ne unhen de rakha hai use chhupe khule kharch karte hain aur buraai ko bhi bhalaai se taalte hain, inhi ke liye aaqibat ka ghar hai.
ayahs.23: Hamesha rehne ke baaghaat jahan yeh khud jaayenge aur un ke baap dadon aur biwiyon aur aulaadon mein se bhi jo neko-kaar honge, un ke paas farishte har har darwaze se aayenge.
ayahs.24: Kahenge ke tum par salaamati ho, sabr ke badle, kya hi achcha (badla) hai is daar-e-aakhirat ka.
ayahs.25: Aur jo Allah ke ahd ko is ki mazbooti ke baad tod dete hain aur jin cheezon ke jodne ka Allah ne hukm diya hai unhen todte hain aur zameen mein fasaad phailaate hain, un ke liye laanaten hain aur un ke liye bura ghar hai.
ayahs.26: Allah Taala jis ki rozi chahta hai badhaata hai aur ghataata hai, yeh to dunya ki zindagi mein mast ho gaye. Halaanke dunya aakhirat ke muqaable mein nihaayat (haqeer) poonji hai.
ayahs.27: Kaafir kehte hain ke is par koi nishani (mojiza) kyun naazil nahin kiya gaya? Jawab de dijiye ke jise Allah gumraah karna chaahe kar deta hai aur jo is ki taraf jhuke use raasta dikha deta hai.
ayahs.28: Jo log imaan laaye un ke dil Allah ke zikr se itminaan haasil karte hain. Yaad rakho Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko tasalli haasil hoti hai.
ayahs.29: Jo log imaan laaye aur jinhon ne nek kaam bhi kiye un ke liye khushhaali hai aur behtareen thikaana.
ayahs.30: Isi tarah hum ne aap ko is ummat mein bheja hai jis se pehle bahut si ummaten guzar chuki hain ke aap unhen hamari taraf se jo wahi aap par utri hai padh kar sunaiye, yeh Allah Rahman ke munkir hain, aap keh dijiye ke mera paalne wala to wahi hai, is ke siwa dar-haqeeqat koi bhi laayeq-e-ibaadat nahin, isi ke oopar mera bharosa hai aur isi ki jaanib mera rujoo hai.
ayahs.31: Agar (bil-farz) kisi Quran (aasmani kitaab) ke zariye pahaad chala diye jaate ya zameen tukde tukde kar di jaati ya murdon se baaten kara di jaatin (phir bhi woh imaan na laate), baat yeh hai ke sab kaam Allah ke haath mein hai, to kya imaan walon ko is baat par dil-jamai nahin ke agar Allah Taala chahe to tamaam logon ko hidayat de de. Kuffaar ko to un ke kufr ke badle hamesha hi koi na koi sakht saza pahunchti rahegi ya un ke makaanon ke qareeb naazil hoti rahegi ta-waqt-ke wada-e-Ilahi aa pahunche. Yaqeenan Allah Taala wada-khilaafi nahin karta.
ayahs.32: Yaqeenan aap se pehle ke paighambaron ka mazaaq udaaya gaya tha aur main ne bhi kaafiron ko dheel di thi phir unhen pakad liya tha, pas mera azaab kaisa raha?
ayahs.33: Aaya woh Allah jo nigehbaani karne wala hai har shakhs ki, is ke kiye hue aamaal par, in logon ne Allah ke shareek thehraaye hain? Keh dijiye zara un ke naam to lo, kya tum Allah ko woh baaten bataate ho jo woh zameen mein jaanta hi nahin, ya sirf oopri oopri baaten bata rahe ho, baat asal yeh hai ke kufr karne walon ke liye un ke makr saja diye gaye hain, aur woh saheeh raah se rok diye gaye hain, aur jis ko Allah gumraah kar de us ko raah dikhaane wala koi nahin.
ayahs.34: Un ke liye dunya ki zindagi mein bhi azaab hai, aur aakhirat ka azaab to bahut hi ziyada sakht hai, unhen Allah ke ghazab se bachaane wala koi bhi nahin.
ayahs.35: Is jannat ki sifat, jis ka wada parhezgaron ko diya gaya hai yeh hai ke is ke neeche se nehren beh rahi hain. Is ka mewa hameshgi wala hai aur is ka saaya bhi. Yeh hai anjaam parhezgaron ka, aur kaafiron ka anjaam-kaar dozakh hai.
ayahs.36: Jinhen hum ne kitaab di hai woh to jo kuchh aap par utaara jaata hai is se khush hote hain aur doosre firqe is ki baaz baaton ke munkir hain. Aap eilaan kar dijiye ke mujhe to sirf yehi hukm diya gaya hai ke main Allah ki ibaadat karoon aur is ke saath shareek na karoon, main isi ki taraf bula raha hoon aur isi ki jaanib mera lautna hai.
ayahs.37: Isi tarah hum ne is Quran ko Arabi zabaan ka farmaan utaara hai. Agar aap ne un ki khwahishon ki pairwi kar li is ke baad ke aap ke paas ilm aa chuka hai to Allah (ke azaabon) se aap ko koi himayati milega aur na bachaane wala.
ayahs.38: Hum aap se pehle bhi bahut se Rasool bhej chuke hain aur hum ne un sab ko biwi bachchon wala banaaya tha, kisi Rasool se nahin ho sakta ke koi nishani baghair Allah ki ijaazat ke le aaye. Har muqarrara wade ki ek likhat hai.
ayahs.39: Allah jo chahe mita de aur jo chahe saabit rakhe, Lauh-e-Mahfooz usi ke paas hai.
ayahs.40: Un se kiye hue wadon mein se koi agar hum aap ko dikha den ya aap ko hum faut kar len to aap par to sirf pahuncha dena hi hai. Hisaab to hamare zimme hi hai.
ayahs.41: Kya woh nahin dekhte? Ke hum zameen ko is ke kinaaron se ghataate chale aa rahe hain, Allah hukm karta hai koi is ke ahkaam peechhe daalne wala nahin, woh jald hisaab lene wala hai.
ayahs.42: In se pehle logon ne bhi apni makkaari mein kami na ki thi, lekin tamaam tadbeeren Allah hi ki hain, jo shakhs jo kuchh kar raha hai Allah ke ilm mein hai. Anqareeb kaafiron ko maloom ho jaayega ke (is) jahan ki jaza kis ke liye hai?
ayahs.43: Yeh kaafir kehte hain ke aap Allah ke Rasool nahin. Aap jawab dijiye ke mujh mein aur tum mein Allah gawahi dene wala kaafi hai aur woh jis ke paas kitaab ka ilm hai.
